title: Concrete D objects and normalized initial G of the filtered homology couple
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ a cochain complex indexed by $\mathbb Z$, and $F^\bullet K^\bullet$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Let $X$ be the fixed concrete filtered homology exact couple and $e_0(p,q)$ its prescribed initial E identification [def-sp-filtered-homology-exact-couple]. Then for every $P,Q\in\mathbb Z$ its explicit D object satisfies $X.D(P,Q)=H^{P+Q}(F^{-Q}K^\bullet)$. Moreover, for every $p,q\in\mathbb Z$, the morphism $X.\mathrm{initialG}(2p+q,-p)$ followed by $e_0(p,q)$ is heterogeneously equal to the map $H^{p+q}(F^pK^\bullet)\to H^{p+q}(\operatorname{gr}^p_F K^\bullet)$ induced by the canonical graded quotient. Here $\mathrm{initialG}$ is the type-zero index-normalized backward map [def-sp-convergence]; heterogeneous equality compares the maps with their explicit, arithmetically equal integer-index expressions. These are computations for the fixed construction, with no finiteness or derived-page hypothesis.

proof.text: The assembled exact couple has D field filteredHomologyD. Expand this abbreviation at P,Q to obtain the filtration-step homology object H^(P+Q)(F^(-Q)K). This is equality of the explicit object expressions, not a choice of an isomorphism.

Expand initialG at type zero and the G field of the assembled couple. The latter is filteredHomologyG, induced on homology by the canonical filtration quotient, with equality transports of its target. Expand the prescribed filteredHomologyEIso. The two target transports compose and cancel. The identities -(-p)=p and (2p+q)+(-p)=p+q identify the quotient map and its degree. Substitution of equal integer indices proves the stated heterogeneous equality.

theorem filteredHomologyExactCouple_computations
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) :
    (∀ P Q : ℤ, (filteredHomologyExactCouple K F).D P Q =
      (F.step (-Q) : CochainComplex C ℤ).homology (P + Q)) ∧
    (∀ p q : ℤ, ((filteredHomologyExactCouple K F).initialG (2 * p + q) (-p) ≫
        (filteredHomologyEIso K F p q).hom) ≍
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)) (p + q))
